method.scope: ALL (all 9 coins pooled, one parameter set)
method.selection: walk-forward and final tuning pick the config with the best search t-stat (lab3 used P&L)
method.shortlist: lab3's: walk-forward P&L > 0, t >= 1.5, >= 50 trades, >= half of test folds profitable; and the family's final config is not sized_exit:ALL itself; one candidate per family
rules: Only data from before lab3's locked holdout was used to pick settings: each family's grid was scored on the lab3 search window (5 folds, all 9 coins pooled), walk-forward exactly as lab3, and the config tuned on the whole search window was frozen and run once on the holdout, the archive and the fresh data.
(1) Holdout profit with t >= 3.35: one-sided Bonferroni at 5% over EVERY test ever run on this holdout (lab3's 112 + the sized_exit combo + lab5's validation peeks + lab5's candidates).
(2) Same league as the best rules: holdout t >= 6, or holdout P&L >= $8,000 with t >= 5.5.
(3) Archive (NEAR, DOGE, BNB, SOL Apr-Aug, never used for tuning) profitable with t >= 4 on >= 50 markets.
(4) Profitable on fresh markets downloaded after the holdout ended (Nov 1-4).
(5) Beats the live all-coin rules on the holdout (P&L > $5,940, t > 4.68), as in lab3.
(6) No more than 40% of its holdout profit from one day; (7) runnable live with data the bot already has (golden_live features; new execution features are listed per candidate).
Rules with several positions per market (re-entry) are scored per MARKET (positions summed), never per trade. Stakes average ~$10 on the search window (Kelly normaliser fixed from the search window).
caveats: lab3's holdout has now been looked at by 110+ rules; even a rule clearing the cumulative bar here is partly selected on noise. The archive and the fresh days are the cleaner checks.
Fresh data are only ~1.5-2.5 days (about 1,800 markets), so a fresh t-stat near 1-2 is all that can be expected.
Maker fills (entry or exit) assume our resting order would have traded whenever the bid/ask high-low or a trade reached its price within the minute; real queues can be worse.
Everything depends on reacting within the minute (see delay1).

families.name: Exit variants (+ sizing)
families.idea: The two best lab3 entries (Kelly-sized and scalp signals) with 20 exit rules: sell at fair value -/+ k cents, only in profit, only until minute 11/13, time stop, trailing stop, model stop-loss, half exits; and 10 stake rules (flat, Kelly capped 3-8x, Kelly^0.5/1.5, edge-, return- and volatility-regime-scaled).
families.finding: Walk-forward t 13.01 (sized_exit:ALL fixed, in-sample folds 2-5: t 9.87); best: All 9 coins · Exit variants (+ sizing) (scalp entry (vol x0.8, 12c edge) +1c; sell at the bid once it is within 2c of fair value; kelly stakes^1.5 capped 5x): $7,025 at t 10.15 (golden).

families.name: Maker exit at fair value
families.idea: Taker entry, then rest a sell at fair value + m cents (re-priced every minute) instead of hitting the bid; optionally still hit the bid once it reaches fair value - k.
families.finding: Walk-forward t 10.58 (sized_exit:ALL fixed, in-sample folds 2-5: t 9.87); best: All 9 coins · Maker exit at fair value (scalp entry (vol x0.8, 12c edge) +2c; rest a sell at fair value +4c, sell at the bid once it is within 2c of fair value; kelly stakes^1.0 capped 3x): $3,992 at t 7.2 (pass).

families.name: Re-entry after an early exit
families.idea: After selling early, the same market may be bought again (either side) if the mispricing re-appears; one position at a time, up to 2-8 round trips per market.
families.finding: Walk-forward t 12.7 (sized_exit:ALL fixed, in-sample folds 2-5: t 9.87); best: All 9 coins · Re-entry after an early exit (scalp entry (vol x0.8, 12c edge) +2c; sell at the bid once it is within 2c of fair value; re-enter up to 2x per market; kelly stakes^1.0 capped 3x): $8,874 at t 10.57 (golden).

families.name: Maker entry + taker exit
families.idea: On the signal rest a buy one cent above the best bid for 1-3 minutes (maker fee) instead of paying the ask; exit as before.
families.finding: Walk-forward t 9.11 (sized_exit:ALL fixed, in-sample folds 2-5: t 9.87); best: All 9 coins · Maker entry + taker exit (scalp entry (vol x0.8, 12c edge) +2c; maker buy at bid+1c for 1 min; sell at the bid once it is within 0c of fair value; kelly stakes^1.0 capped 3x): $4,714 at t 6.15 (pass).

families.name: Entry timing
families.idea: Only enter when the gap is wider than a minute ago (edge growing), when the signal has held for two minutes (confirmation), or when it is narrowing (control).
families.finding: Walk-forward t 12.87 (sized_exit:ALL fixed, in-sample folds 2-5: t 9.87); best: All 9 coins · Entry timing (scalp entry (vol x0.8, 12c edge) +2c; edge growing; sell at the bid once it is within 2c of fair value; kelly stakes^1.0 capped 3x): $7,064 at t 9.33 (golden).

families.name: Portfolio cap on same-direction bets
families.idea: All 9 coins tend to move together inside a 15-minute window. Allow at most K same-direction positions per window (first come, or biggest edge first).
families.finding: Walk-forward t 11.18 (sized_exit:ALL fixed, in-sample folds 2-5: t 9.87); best: All 9 coins · Portfolio cap on same-direction bets (scalp entry (vol x0.8, 12c edge); sell at the bid once it is within 0c of fair value; max 6 same-direction coins per window (first); kelly stakes^1.0 capped 3x): $7,144 at t 9.06 (golden).

families.name: Other lab3 entries with sizing + exits
families.idea: The other golden all-coin lab3 entries (fresh-move/lagging quote, recalibrated, momentum, bootstrap, EWMA vol, re-tuned, fat-tail) and three ensembles of them, each with Kelly stakes and the early exit.
families.finding: Walk-forward t 13.54 (sized_exit:ALL fixed, in-sample folds 2-5: t 9.87); best: All 9 coins · Other lab3 entries with sizing + exits (lag entry +1c; sell at the bid once it is within 2c of fair value; kelly stakes^1.0 capped 3x): $6,928 at t 9.46 (golden).

families.name: Best pieces combined
families.idea: Designed after the search-window results of the families above (holdout untouched): the strongest entries (scalp, fresh-move/lagging quote, EWMA vol, recalibrated, 4-model ensemble) with edge offsets, edge-growing timing, exit at fair value or within 2c, one re-entry, Kelly stakes, and an optional 6-coin same-direction cap.
